profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am an accomplished software engineer specializing in writing user interface software for medical devices that plug into laptops and tablets. I am known for being friendly and approachable in communicating with all different levels of coworkers and customers to find solutions to software issues.

I can be contacted at this address: kennethajohnson@comcast.net

Specialties: Medical Device Software, Electronic Medical Record(EMR) integration, internationalization and localization of software, Visual Studio, C++, C#, .NET, SQL Server

Medical Devices:  Electrocardiogram(ECG), Spirometer, Oximeter, Blood Pressure

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Writing software to improve the process and workflow at Rosemount Flow's global factories.  Team member in Rosemount Flow's manufacturing test system's group.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Currently assigned to Emerson Process Management
positions.description:
Updating the Field Device Integration(FDI) application for the Reliability Solutions group at Emerson Process Management. The field devices are used to measure the flow of air, steam and water in oil refineries. Updated the application for better performance and data reporting.

Device communication protocols: Hart, Profibus, Fieldbus

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Original author of QRS Diagnostic's Office Medic program, which provides an interface to their medical devices.   The QRS Diagnostic medical devices include the Universal ECG cable, the SpirOx card which measures lung function and oxygen saturation, and the BPCard which measures blood pressure.

The software is created using Visual C++ and C#.  The software runs on Windows Vista, Windows 7 and Windows 8.

Updated driver software to run on 64 bit Windows 7 computers.

Integrated Office Medic with Cerner and Allscripts Electronic Medical Record(EMR) System.  Wrote a C# application to integrate Office Medic into these EMRs.

Worked closely with customers on evaluating and integrating ECG diagnostic algorithm.

Updated ECG diagnostic algorithm to work on 64-bit Windows 7 and Windows Vista.  The diagnostic algorithm is a 20,000 line C DLL program developed by a company in France.

Performed necessary software tasks to translate Office Medic into Japanese.  Supervised software validation in Japan.  Created satellite dlls in MFC to hold the translation strings.

Created the Spirometry software as a brand new application for both Windows Mobile and Windows.  

Converted Office Medic application into MFC components that can be called from managed code in Visual Studio.NET

Managed contract to develop driver for Spiro and SpirOx Card.  Moved spirometry and oximetry calculation code from WDM driver to separate dll.  The dll was written to work on both the Windows and Pocket PC platform.

positions.title: Electronics Engineer
positions.description:
Developed an application called Bid Module with XVT.  XVT is a C++ cross platform system that allows software to be written for Windows, Macintosh and UNIX using one set of source code.  XVT works in conjunction with the Borland C++ compiler.  Bid Module connects to an Oracle database.  Bid Module is a management information system used to track bids on manufactured parts.

Using the C language, developed the Macintosh version of EDMICS (Engineering Data Management Information Control System) Desktop viewing.  EDMICS Desktop Viewing downloads images from an Oracle database.  

Lead developer for the Computer Aided Process Control System (CAPCS), a Macintosh system used to display and record data from torpedo upgrade procedures

honors.title: President's Award
honors.description: In recognition of your superior effort and dedication to our company.
